pass_a_gloss: Who is the one saying: 'Through me was destroyed all the earth by destruction'? Christ says these [things], who before the departure [of the people] indeed many [things] had happened [as] sins to the people, but not such [things] that they should be completely abandoned and handed over to a long captivity. But when they filled up 'the measure of the fathers' of them and added to having slain the prophets and having feared the righteous [the act of] killing 'the Christ of God', then it happened [that was said] 'Your house is left to you desolate.' And indeed they suffered these things, and 'all the earth was destroyed by destruction'.
